query: I have a 65-year-old woman in ICU with mixed shock. In female ICU patients 60–70 with mixed shock, what is the cohort 95th‑percentile instability score (first 48 h)? Compare top decile versus cohort for hypotension (MAP<65), tachycardia, ICU LOS, and mortality.
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.95) within GROUP (ORDER BY (outtime - intime)) AS cohort_95th_percentile, percentile_cont(0.1) within GROUP (ORDER BY (outtime - intime)) AS top_decile FROM patient_stay;
